# MKCinema

> MKCinema is a free, open-source home cinema for the whole family. Tomorrow’s cinema, for the whole house: it works with Stremio-compatible addons and gives a seat (profile) for everyone in the house, watch parties with voice and cameras, and a phone that works as a remote. It runs on Android, Android TV and Fire TV, Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and iPad (as a Home Screen web app), smart TVs, and any modern browser. Every feature is free forever: no ads, no paid tier, open source under GPL-3.0.

Key facts:

- Price: free. There is no paid plan and nothing is locked. Donations through Ko-fi are optional and unlock nothing.
- Content: MKCinema hosts no films, shows or channels. Catalogues, subtitles and streams come from addons that each user installs. The only built-in video is official trailers.
- Debrid: works with the major debrid services using the user's own key. MKCinema does not recommend one service over another.
- Accounts: optional. Sign in with email and password to sync library, progress, addons and settings across devices.
- Languages: the app and website are available in English plus 30 other languages.
- Made by: Dee Lavish, an independent developer. Source code on GitHub.
- Not affiliated with Stremio. Stremio is a trademark of its owner.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://mkcinema.app/guides/): every MKCinema guide in one place
- [Stremio addons](https://mkcinema.app/stremio-addons/): use your Stremio-compatible addons in MKCinema, and move over from Stremio
- [Addon health check](https://mkcinema.app/addon-check/): free tool that finds a slow, broken or blocked addon, in the browser
- [Fire TV and Android TV](https://mkcinema.app/fire-tv/): install MKCinema on a TV with the Downloader app
- [iPhone and iPad](https://mkcinema.app/iphone-ipad/): add the web app to the Home Screen from Safari
- [MKV in the browser](https://mkcinema.app/mkv-in-browser/): how MKV files and Dolby or DTS audio play in a browser
- [Skip intro and credits](https://mkcinema.app/skip-intro/): where skip times come from and how to turn skipping on
